stories.title: Fed may get pulled into Bessent's push to prop up the yen
stories.summary: An analysis from CNBC suggests Treasury Secretary Bessent's effort to support Japan's weakened yen could end up drawing the Federal Reserve into the picture, adding a currency dimension to the Fed's usual domestic mandate. The piece frames yen support as a policy question that may not stay confined to the Treasury and Bank of Japan alone.
stories.whyItMatters: A weak yen affects global capital flows, U.S. Treasury demand, and Fed policy calculus at a moment when the central bank is already under scrutiny — any hint of coordinated currency intervention would be a significant shift for markets.
whatToWatch: Any statement from the Fed or Treasury on currency coordination
Yen levels against the dollar in coming sessions
Bank of Japan policy signals
questions: What specific mechanism would pull the Fed into yen support?
Would this require formal coordination with the Bank of Japan?

stories.title: Palantir jumps 12% as U.S. commercial revenue soars nearly 150%
stories.summary: Palantir shares surged 12% after a quarterly report that beat expectations, driven by U.S. commercial revenue growth of nearly 150%. Coverage from CNBC and MarketWatch both point to AI-driven demand as the engine behind the acceleration.
stories.whyItMatters: Palantir's results are a closely watched read on how much real revenue AI demand is translating into for software companies beyond the hyperscalers, reinforcing the AI-trade narrative running through this earnings season.
whatToWatch: Management commentary on forward bookings and government vs. commercial mix
Whether other software names cite similar AI-driven commercial acceleration
questions: How much of the commercial growth is new customers vs. expansion of existing accounts?
